title: A High Content Imaging and Machine Learning Approach to Identify the Anti-Cancer Effect of Novel Small Molecules on Brain Cancer Patient-Derived Organoids
content: Brain tumors are some of the most difficult-to-treat cancer types, and according to a recent Saudi cancer registry, more than 300 new brain cancer patients, accounting for 2.8% of cancer cases, were reported in 2016. Intra-tumor heterogeneity plays a major role in the aggressive behavior of brain tumors. Glioblastoma, for example, has a very poor prognosis rate, and only 5% of patients survive past five years of diagnosis [1].
